## Analysis overview

Orders treatment and termination categories, calculates completion counts and percentages, summarizes reasons among early terminators, and adds Fisher exact test p-values for selected comparisons.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `ARM`: randomized treatment arm
- `COMP24FL`: Week 24 completion flag
- `DCREASCD`: coded reason for discontinuation
- `DCDECOD`: standardized disposition outcome
- `USUBJID`: unique subject identifier.
